summary: Streaming session stalls mid-generation after transient latency spike (mobile carrier)
description: Issue summary: Customer reports streaming chat sessions (SSE) stall mid-generation after ~15-40s, client receives no more chunks but TCP connection remains ESTABLISHED. Impact: Several customers on dedicated cluster observed partial outputs and manual reconnects, user-facing UIs show hanging 'typing' indicator. Environment: Dedicated capacity for OptiCart in prod-us-west running our streaming API via HTTP/1.1 SSE proxy. Steps to reproduce: 1) Customer sends multi-turn prompt causing long generation (~600 tokens). 2) Stream starts and emits tokens for ~15-40s. 3) Stream stops emitting further data while connection stays open; no final event. 4) Client reconnects and requests fallback but receives duplicate tokens or must restart generation. Logs: See attached snippets and trace ids below. Additional context: Incident coincided with mobile carrier RTT spike reported by customer; customer is primarily mobile web users. This started after rolling proxy tuning change (kernel TCP offload flags and proxy buffering) deployed 2026-03-09.
steps_to_reproduce: Use mobile network (3G/4G) or simulate high RTT with tc/netem (200-400ms)
Open SSE connection to /v1/chat/stream with streaming enabled and long generation prompt (~600 tokens)
Observe initial token stream for 15-40s, then silence while TCP connection remains open
Reconnect client and note duplicate or partial content behavior

investigation_notes: Initial triage: reproduces reliably when artificial downstream RTT >200ms and packet reordering introduced via tc/netem.
Hypothesis A: upstream proxy buffering introduced after recent tuning prevents timely flush of chunked SSE payloads under high RTT paths.
Hypothesis B: HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.1 translation layer intermittently stalls on connection windows when downstream ACKs are delayed, leaving connection open without further application writes.
Datadog traces show consistent pattern: last application write followed by series of delayed ACKs from downstream, proxy does not trigger application-level retry or reset.
No obvious errors from serving-runtime; model continued generating tokens and writing to local buffer (confirmed by local logs), but proxy did not forward subsequent chunks.
impact_summary: Affects interactive chat UX for OptiCart mobile users; estimated ~12% of long-generation sessions observed stall in last 48 hours. Customer reported support tickets and increased manual reconnects, causing poor UX and drop in completion rates.
timeline: 2026-03-09 03:00 UTC - Proxy tuning change deployed (PR #412) adjusting sendfile and tcp_offload flags on streaming workers.
2026-03-10 13:40 UTC - OptiCart support pinged Redwood support: repeated mid-stream stalls.
2026-03-10 14:00 UTC - Support created this ticket and engaged SRE/Streaming team.
2026-03-10 16:30 UTC - SRE reproduced locally using netem and confirmed stall pattern.
2026-03-11 09:00 UTC - Temporary mitigation deployed: reverted proxy send-buffer tuning and enabled periodic keepalive chunk every 10s for streaming sessions.
2026-03-12 18:00 UTC - Customer confirmed fallback reduced stall rate to <1% during monitored window.
2026-03-13 11:00 UTC - Engineering scheduled permanent fix and test harness improvements.
actions_taken: Reverted proxy tuning flags from PR #412 in prod us-west for dedicated clusters (temporary rollback)
Enabled periodic 10s heartbeat chunk for SSE sessions to avoid silent stalls behind high RTT networks
Added netem-based e2e test in CI to simulate downstream RTT and packet reordering for streaming endpoints
resolution: Partial mitigation in place: rollback of proxy tuning and heartbeat chunk reduced incidents to <1% for OptiCart. Permanent fix: modify proxy streaming flush logic to flush on application write regardless of TCP send-buffer heuristics and add aggressive window update for long-lived streams. Engineering to implement and validate in canary by 2026-03-20.
